overview: The committee reviewed and approved the summer council newsletter, discussed planning and logistics for upcoming ward meetings, and held a discussion on revising the city's outdated noise ordinance.

items.title: Summer Newsletter Approval
items.summary: The committee approved the summer newsletter covering city council business for July and August.

items.title: Ward Meetings Schedule and Planning
items.summary: The committee reviewed the schedules, venues, and promotional plans for upcoming neighborhood ward meetings.

items.title: Noise Ordinance Revision Discussion
items.summary: The committee discussed updates to the city's 1974 noise ordinance, comparing enforcement strategies and standards from neighboring municipalities, and voted to retain the matter in committee for future drafts.
